description: Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures - 11 recommended disclosures across 4 pillars

Governance.description: Disclose the organization's governance around climate-related risks and opportunities.

recommendations.title: Board oversight
recommendations.description: Describe the board's oversight of climate-related risks and opportunities.
requirements: Processes and frequency by which the board and/or committees are informed about climate-related issues
Whether the board considers climate-related issues when reviewing strategy, budgets and major plans
How the board monitors and oversees progress against climate-related goals and targets

recommendations.title: Management's role
recommendations.description: Describe management's role in assessing and managing climate-related risks and opportunities.
requirements: Whether climate-related responsibilities are assigned to management-level positions or committees
Description of the associated organizational structure
Processes by which management is informed about and monitors climate-related issues

Strategy.description: Disclose the actual and potential impacts of climate-related risks and opportunities on the organization's businesses, strategy, and financial planning where such information is material.

recommendations.title: Climate risks and opportunities
recommendations.description: Describe the climate-related risks and opportunities the organization has identified over the short, medium, and long term.
requirements: Relevant short-, medium- and long-term time horizons
Specific climate-related issues for each time horizon that could have a material financial impact
Processes used to determine which risks and opportunities could have a material financial impact

recommendations.title: Business and financial impact
recommendations.description: Describe the impact of climate-related risks and opportunities on the organization's businesses, strategy, and financial planning.
requirements: Impact on products and services, supply chain, adaptation and mitigation activities, R&D and operations
How climate-related issues serve as an input to financial planning
Impact on financial performance and financial position

recommendations.title: Organisational resilience
recommendations.description: Describe the resilience of the organization's strategy, taking into consideration different climate-related scenarios, including a 2°C or lower scenario.
requirements: Climate-related scenarios and time horizons considered
Inclusion of a 2°C or lower scenario
Where the strategy may be affected and how it might change to address potential risks

Risk Management.description: Disclose how the organization identifies, assesses, and manages climate-related risks.

recommendations.title: Risk identification and assessment
recommendations.description: Describe the organization's processes for identifying and assessing climate-related risks.
requirements: Risk management processes for identifying and assessing climate-related risks
How the organization determines the relative significance of climate-related risks
Whether existing and emerging regulatory requirements are considered

recommendations.title: Risk management processes
recommendations.description: Describe the organization's processes for managing climate-related risks.
requirements: Processes for managing climate-related risks, including decisions to mitigate, transfer, accept or control
Processes for prioritizing climate-related risks
How materiality determinations are made

recommendations.title: Integration into overall risk management
recommendations.description: Describe how processes for identifying, assessing, and managing climate-related risks are integrated into the organization's overall risk management.
requirements: How climate-related risk processes are integrated into overall (enterprise) risk management

Metrics & Targets.description: Disclose the metrics and targets used to assess and manage relevant climate-related risks and opportunities where such information is material.

recommendations.title: Climate-related metrics
recommendations.description: Disclose the metrics used by the organization to assess climate-related risks and opportunities in line with its strategy and risk management process.
requirements: Key metrics used to measure and manage climate-related risks and opportunities
Whether and how performance metrics are incorporated into remuneration policies
Internal carbon prices and climate-related opportunity metrics, where relevant

recommendations.title: Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions
recommendations.description: Disclose Scope 1, Scope 2, and, if appropriate, Scope 3 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, and the related risks.
requirements: Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions
Scope 3 GHG emissions, if appropriate
Methodology (e.g. GHG Protocol) and historical periods for trend analysis

recommendations.title: Climate targets and performance
recommendations.description: Describe the targets used by the organization to manage climate-related risks and opportunities and performance against targets.
requirements: Key climate-related targets (e.g. GHG emissions, energy usage)
Time frames and base years for targets
Key performance indicators used to assess progress against targets

metadata.source: TCFD Final Report (2017), Recommendations of the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures
